arxiv-2205-12650.title: Few-shot Reranking for Multi-hop QA via Language Model Prompting
arxiv-2205-12650.creator: Muhammad Khalifa, Lajanugen Logeswaran, Moontae Lee, Honglak Lee, Lu Wang, University of Michigan, LG AI Research, University of Illinois at Chicago
arxiv-2205-12650.description: Abstract We study few-shot reranking for multi-hop QA with open-domain questions. To alleviate the need for a large number of labeled question-document pairs for retriever training, we propose PromptRank , which relies on language model prompting for multi-hop path reranking.

arxiv-2209-06277.title: Spatiotemporal patterning of extensile active stresses in microtubule-based active fluids
arxiv-2209-06277.creator: Linnea M. Lemma 1,2 , Minu Varghese 1 , Tyler D. Ross 3,4 , Matt Thomson 4 , Aparna Baskaran 1 , and Zvonimir Dogic 2,1
arxiv-2209-06277.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Linnea M. Lemma 1,2 , Minu Varghese 1 , Tyler D. Ross 3,4 , Matt Thomson 4 , Aparna Baskaran 1 , and Zvonimir Dogic 2,1. Active stresses, which are collectively generated by the motion of energy-consuming rod-like constituents, generate chaotic autonomous flows. Controlling active stresses in space and time is an essential prerequisite for controlling the intrinsically chaotic dynamics of extensile active fluids.

arxiv-2302-04053.title: Gatemon qubit based on a thin InAs-Al hybrid nanowire
arxiv-2302-04053.creator: Jierong Huo, Zezhou Xia, Zonglin Li, Shan Zhang, Yuqing Wang, Dong Pan, Qichun Liu, Yulong Liu, Zhichuan Wang, Yichun Gao, Jianhua Zhao, Tiefu Li, Jianghua Ying, Runan Shang, Hao Zhang
arxiv-2302-04053.description: Abstract We study a gate-tunable superconducting qubit (gatemon) based on a thin InAs-Al hybrid nanowire. Using a gate voltage to control its Josephson energy, the gatemon can reach the strong coupling regime to a microwave cavity. In the dispersive regime, we extract the energy relaxation time T 1 ∼ T_{1}\sim 0.

arxiv-2401-06693.title: Probability density functions for photon propagation in a binary (isotropic-Poisson) statistical mixture with unmatched positives/negatives refractive indexes
arxiv-2401-06693.creator: Tiziano Binzoni, Alain Mazzolo
arxiv-2401-06693.description: Abstract The exact homogenized probability density function, for a photon making a step of length s s has been analytically derived for a binary (isotropic-Poisson) statistical mixture with unmatched refractive indexes. The companions, exact, homogenized probability density function for a photon to change direction (“scatter”) with an angle ϑ \vartheta , and the homogenized albedo, have also been obtained analytically.

arxiv-2406-01453.description: Abstract . The Cauchy-Szegő singular integral is a fundamental tool in the study of holomorphic H p H^{p} Hardy space. But for a kind of Siegel domains, the Cauchy-Szegő kernels are neither product ones nor flag ones on the Shilov boundaries, which have the structure of nilpotent Lie groups 𝒩 \mathscr{N} of step two.

arxiv-2410-15743.title: Toeing the Party Line: Election Manifestos as a Key to Understand Political Discourse on Twitter
arxiv-2410-15743.creator: Maximilian Maurer, Tanise Ceron, Sebastian Padó and Gabriella Lapesa
arxiv-2410-15743.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Maximilian Maurer, Tanise Ceron, Sebastian Padó and Gabriella Lapesa. Political discourse on Twitter is a moving target: politicians continuously make statements about their positions. It is therefore crucial to track their discourse on social media to understand their ideological positions and goals. However, Twitter data is also challenging to work with since it is ambiguous and often dependent on social context, and consequently, recent work on political positioning has tended to focus strongly on manifestos (parties’ electoral programs) rather than social media.

pmc-10481491.title: The effects of a Journey of the Brave Counseling Program on anxiety, well-being, and life adjustment in Taiwanese children
pmc-10481491.creator: Hsiu-Lan Shelley Tien, Yi-Ning Su, Aizi Zhang, Isana Kaichi, Takako Koshiba, Sho Okawa, Yuko Urao, Eiji Shimizu
pmc-10481491.description: The purposes of the current study are two-fold. Study 1 aimed to examine the psychometric properties of the Spence Children’s Anxiety Scale (SCAS) in a Taiwanese sample. Study 2 aimed to explore the immediate and follow-up effects of Journey of the Brave Counseling Program (JBCP) on children’s’ anxiety, well-being, and life adjustment.

pmc-11485362.title: Golden-angle radial sparse parallel (GRASP) magnetic resonance angiography (MRA) for endoleak evaluation after endovascular repair of the aorta: a prospective comparison to conventional time-resolved MRA
pmc-11485362.creator: Haidara Almansour, Migdat Mustafi, Mario Lescan, Ulrich Grosse, Mateja Andic, Jörg Schmehl, Christoph Artzner, Gerd Grözinger, Sven S Walter
pmc-11485362.description: BackgroundTime-resolved angiography with interleaved stochastic trajectories (TWIST) magnetic resonance angiography (MRA) may obscure smaller vessels and is highly susceptibility to motion artifacts, potentially reducing endoleak detection accuracy after endovascular aortic repair (EVAR). The novel golden-angle radial sparse parallel (GRASP) sequence enhances spatial and temporal resolution with continuous, motion-robust datasets, showing promise for accurate endoleak detection post-EVAR.

pmc-11535018.title: Insights and caveats from mining local and global temporal motifs in cryptocurrency transaction networks
pmc-11535018.creator: Naomi A. Arnold, Peijie Zhong, Cheick Tidiane Ba, Ben Steer, Raul Mondragon, Felix Cuadrado, Renaud Lambiotte, Richard G. Clegg
pmc-11535018.description: Distributed ledger technologies have opened up a wealth of fine-grained transaction data from cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum. This allows research into problems like anomaly detection, anti-money laundering, pattern mining and activity clustering (where data from traditional currencies is rarely available).

pmc-11693248.title: “IT TAKES A SPECIAL PERSON”: EXPLORING NURSING STUDENTS’ END-OF-LIFE CARE EXPERIENCES AND ITS INFLUENCE ON EMOTIONS
pmc-11693248.creator: Kalei Kowalchik
pmc-11693248.description: Navigating end-of-life care as a nursing student can results in intense emotions such as grief and despair and there is limited research on undergraduate nursing students’ thoughts and experiences on the need for emotional support resources when caring for patients and families at the end of life.

pmc-12561603.title: Exploring the Link Between Body Appreciation and Health-Related Lifestyle in Adolescents: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12561603.creator: Migle Baceviciene, Laima Trinkuniene, Rasa Jankauskiene
pmc-12561603.description: Adolescence is a critical developmental stage at which body image and lifestyle behaviours intersect. Research shows that having a positive body image during this period is linked to better mental health and certain aspects of a healthy lifestyle. However, more empirical evidence is needed, especially concerning boys.

pmc-12642238.title: Evaluating primary suicide prevention in adolescents with risk factors (ESPAIR): study protocol for a cluster-randomized controlled trial
pmc-12642238.creator: Stéphanie Baggio, Eleanor Bailey, Anne Edan, Patrick Heller, Carole Kapp, Nadejda Lambert, Laurent Michaud, Adrian P. Mundt, Neslie Nsingi, Sophia Perez, Santiago Peregalli, Camille Piguet, Caroline Piotrowski, Yekaterina Prutyanova, Mathias Rumley, Marlène Sapin, Sébastien Urben, Katia Iglesias
pmc-12642238.description: BackgroundSuicide is the leading cause of death among young people. Because it is preventable, suicide prevention has become a critical public health priority worldwide. Current evidence suggests that primary suicide prevention interventions are effective in promoting suicide awareness and reducing suicidal thoughts among adolescents.

pmc-12690783.title: The usefulness of full-thickness biopsy during semi-rigid pleuroscopy for differentiating between malignant pleural mesothelioma and non-specific pleurisy
pmc-12690783.creator: Takahiro Ueda, Toshiyuki Nakai, Sayaka Tanaka, Hiroaki Nagamine, Atsushi Miyamoto, Misako Nishimura, Yoshiya Matsumoto, Kanako Sato, Kazuhiro Yamada, Tetsuya Watanabe, Kazuhisa Asai, Yuji Matsumoto, Yu Mikami, Tomoya Kawaguchi
pmc-12690783.description: BackgroundMalignant pleural mesothelioma is a rare disease with a poor prognosis; distinguishing it from non-specific pleurisy is essential for determining an appropriate treatment strategy. We aimed to evaluate the diagnostic utility and safety of full-thickness biopsy performed during semi-rigid pleuroscopy under local anaesthesia to differentiate between malignant pleural mesothelioma and non-specific pleurisy.

pmc-12767023.title: Determinants of Delivery Mode Preferences and Decision‐Making Among Jordanian Women: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-12767023.creator: Hala Bawadi, Zaid Hamdan, Nagham Abu Shaqra, Maher Maaitah, Abdelmanie Suleimat, Asma Basha, Shawqi Saleh, Mazen El -Zibdah, Raja Khater, Ahmad Abdulla, Nidhi Chaudhary
pmc-12767023.description: BackgroundThe birthing process presents women with both physical and emotional challenges. In recent years, there has been a notable global rise in cesarean section (CS) rates—particularly elective CS—including in Jordan. Numerous personal, cultural, and healthcare system–related factors contribute to women′s increasing preference for CS over vaginal delivery.

pmc-13219868.title: MCAMamba: A multimodal method with bidirectional cross-attention and state space model for cancer survival prediction
pmc-13219868.creator: Haiyan Cui, Xiaofei Liu, Weiping Ding, Weixing Wang
pmc-13219868.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cancer survival prediction is crucial for clinical decision-making and personalized treatment planning. The joint analysis of pathological images and genomic profiles provides complementary information at both histological and molecular levels, offering a more comprehensive foundation for patient prognosis assessment. However, existing multimodal survival prediction methods face two major challenges: (1) How to efficiently capture global dependencies in high-dimensional, long sequence features while maintaining linear complexity?

pmc-13480363.title: From Gut to Brain: Probiotics as an Emerging Adjunctive Strategy for Insomnia and Sleep Disturbances
pmc-13480363.creator: Yutao Yang, Haoran Zhang
pmc-13480363.description: ObjectiveToo little sleep and incidental insomnia are two common conditions in which sleep is disrupted. Insomnia is often accompanied by emotional, metabolic, and immunological deterioration. The purpose of this narrative review is to better understand the gut-brain axis and evaluate the potential usefulness of probiotics in the treatment of insomnia and related sleep problems.
